summary: SUB-08 step 1: extract proxy security, forward and pure decide helpers from proxy.py

delivery.outcome: proxy.py loses 360 lines: browser origin/bearer checks move to proxy_security, raw-forward timeout and usage parsing to proxy_forward, and the pure System One question/probability/d1 shaping to proxy_decide; proxy.py re-exports every moved name so imports and test seams are unchanged. Four CC hotspots (38, 24, 21, 20) are split into helpers with CC <= 12.
nonGoals: No behaviour change: identical pins pass against origin/main and this branch.
Names that tests monkeypatch on subllm.proxy (urlopen, liveness, _complete_*, catalog readers) stay in proxy.py for later steps.
Handler methods and compile_catalog are later SUB-08 steps.

architecture.decision: Split by responsibility into I/O-free modules; proxy.py keeps the handler and the I/O seams and re-exports moved names with redundant aliases.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; no data or configuration involved.

validation.evidence: behaviour pins also pass against origin/main implementations
